newsitem.title: LATVIA: EU PHARE CROSS BORDER PROGRAMME 5 MLN ECU IN 1997.
newsitem.headline: EU PHARE CROSS BORDER PROGRAMME 5 MLN ECU IN 1997.

text.p: Latvia will receive five million ecu in 1997 within the framwork of the EU PHARE cross-border co-operation programme, the finance ministry said on Thursday.
The Baltic co-operation committee plenary meeting of the cross-border programme was opened Thursday in Riga by Latvian Finance Minister Rober Zile.
Latvia sees the programme as an important mechanism in creating links between the countries of the Baltic sea region, the finance minister said in a statement.
Latvia has received 11 million ecu since 1994, when the programme was launched to develop infrastructure and clean up pollution in the Baltic Sea.
Some six million ecu was spent on environment projects and another five million was used to upgrade harbours and transport infrastructure.
The plenary session plans to discuss its long-term strategy to 1999.
